activity.notes: Modern Croatian reference scholarship places Tomislav's rule approximately from 910 to 928. Thomas the Archdeacon explicitly calls him dux in 914, whereas a papal letter associated with the 925 Split council addresses him as rex. ATLAS therefore separates the pre-royal Croatian princely phase c.910-c.925 from the existing c.925-c.928 Kingdom of Croatia Activity, without asserting a specific coronation date or ceremony.
